faq.q: What is an AI Facebook ad from a product photo?
faq.a: A square photo or a tall clip made from a product link or a photo you upload. A presenter made by AI can hold the item and speak a script. That person is not a real customer.

faq.q: Can this lower my Facebook ad costs?
faq.a: We do not promise cheaper ad results. You can make another version, with another actor or line, without paying for a new photo shoot. Each file spends credits, and you see the amount first.

faq.q: Are these files allowed in Facebook ads?
faq.a: Follow the current ad rules for the country where the ad will run. If Ads Manager (Facebook's ad tool) asks you to mark the ad as AI, do that there. We do not guarantee approval.

faq.q: Do people know the ad is AI-made?
faq.a: The file does not pretend a person in it is a real customer. If Facebook asks you to mark the ad as AI, do that in Ads Manager when you publish.

faq.q: What does a Facebook clip cost?
faq.a: A 6-second clip is 24 credits, 10 seconds is 40, 15 is 60, and 30 is 120. You see the price before you start. A photo is 24 credits. If a job fails, those credits come back on their own.

faq.q: Where do the headline and the price go?
faq.a: Add the headline, the price, and the button when you publish to Meta (Facebook and Instagram's ad system). Or add them in Ads Manager after you download. The clip can already include a spoken script and on-screen captions.

faq.q: Does the file include sound, captions or music?
faq.a: Yes. A clip can include a spoken voice, captions, and a music track. Change them in the editor, then publish to Meta or download. The file has no watermark.

faq.q: How do I turn a product link into a Facebook ad?
faq.a: Paste the product page. We bring in the pictures and the description, draft a script, and you pick an actor and a voice. Then publish to Meta, or download the file.

faq.q: How should I compare two versions?
faq.a: Change one thing at a time, such as the actor or the first line. Then use [how to test ad versions](/guides/testing-ad-versions) before you spend more on the winner. You can make those versions together from the same link.
